_meta.description: Compose batch of one reference slot (total_pop) plus one target slot (audience_a) over region x segment decorated with an OVERLAY_RANK matrix-scope compose overlay that emits the 1-based rank of each target cell within the target matrix (1 = largest). Population mode controlled by Params.population ("row" | "column" | "matrix"; defaults to "matrix"). The reference slot anchors the resolution + key-set alignment gates but is NOT consumed by the rank math itself — the rank intentionally reads only the target cells; the reference's structural schema is the alignment constraint. Ties take the average rank (canonical scipy.stats.rankdata default). Absent cells stay absent on the overlay; they do NOT participate in the population's denominator. Buffered (Compose-host kind).
_meta.name: compose-rank
